Question:
In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(AC=6\) cm, \(BC=8\) cm, and \(AB=10\) cm. \(CD\) is the altitude to hypotenuse \(AB\). Find the length of \(CD\) (unit: cm; a decimal answer is allowed).

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_112_q4_question_en.svg)
Solution: Using two ways to calculate the area, \(AC\times BC\div2=AB\times CD\div2\), giving \(CD=6\times8\div10=4.8\).
